contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An early-medieval silver penny of Aethelred II (978-1016), long cross type (North 774; c .997-1003), mint: Huntingdon, moneyer: Aelfric. Ref: North 1994: 159. Obverse shows A bare-headed bust left. Obverse legend reads ÆÐELRED REX ANGLO. Reverse shows a long cross voided, single pellet at centre, each limb terminating in three crescents.
